Messages.Author: Prince of Berlin
Messages.Body:
Hi. Here are some old and new rule-questions. Thanks in advance for
answering.

1. IMMORTAL GRAPPLE and GHOUL RETAINER. Is it possible for a Minion
with a GR, that the Retainer uses i. e. a Gun against the opposing
Minion who played IG?

2. CARRION CROWS, GHOUL RETAINER, WOLF COMPANIN etc. and PULLED FANGS.
Is the damage from CC, GR, WC dealt by the minion? So, is it possible
to play PF after doing 2 damage (hand strike for 1 + CC inferior)[when
the opposing minion does only one or less]?

3. During the last tournament a player wanted to play a Master:Skill
on an uncontrolled vampire, because of card text "play on a vampire".
Is this possible?

4. A minion played both UNDEAD PERSISTENCE and IG. He has two optional
presses. Can he use one to press for second round and safe the other
to press later for third round?

5. Is it possible to play more than one Trap each round for more than
one press or to get rid of cards?

6. Is it possible to prevent 2 points of damage with two SKIN OF ROCK
inferior?

7. Lucian is bleeding with Bonding, Sir Walter Nash is tapped but
plays 2nd Tradition. Can he play now DEFLECTION instead of blocking,
when Lucian plays no more stealth?

Greetings.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Prince of Berlin wrote:
>
> Hi. Here are some old and new rule-questions. Thanks in advance for
> answering.
>
> 1. IMMORTAL GRAPPLE and GHOUL RETAINER. Is it possible for a Minion
> with a GR, that the Retainer uses i. e. a Gun against the opposing
> Minion who played IG?

Yes.

> 2. CARRION CROWS, GHOUL RETAINER, WOLF COMPANIN etc. and PULLED FANGS.
> Is the damage from CC, GR, WC dealt by the minion? So, is it possible
> to play PF after doing 2 damage (hand strike for 1 + CC inferior)[when
> the opposing minion does only one or less]?

No to all three.
So, no.

> 3. During the last tournament a player wanted to play a Master:Skill
> on an uncontrolled vampire, because of card text "play on a vampire".
> Is this possible?

No, because of the rules [1.6.1.5]

> 4. A minion played both UNDEAD PERSISTENCE and IG. He has two optional
> presses. Can he use one to press for second round and safe the other
> to press later for third round?

No. Effects of combat cards apply only to the current round by default.

> 5. Is it possible to play more than one Trap each round for more than
> one press or to get rid of cards?

Yes, but only on the first round.

> 6. Is it possible to prevent 2 points of damage with two SKIN OF ROCK
> inferior?

Yes.

> 7. Lucian is bleeding with Bonding, Sir Walter Nash is tapped but
> plays 2nd Tradition. Can he play now DEFLECTION instead of blocking,
> when Lucian plays no more stealth?

No. He must attempt to block by card text on 2nd Tradition.

--
LSJ (vte...@white-wolf.com) V:TES Net.Rep for White Wolf, Inc.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <8f9f4861.0107...@posting.google.com>, Prince of
Berlin <kribs...@hotmail.com> writes

>1. IMMORTAL GRAPPLE and GHOUL RETAINER. Is it possible for a Minion
>with a GR, that the Retainer uses i. e. a Gun against the opposing
>Minion who played IG?

Yes.

The GR isn't striking, it's just doing damage.

>2. CARRION CROWS, GHOUL RETAINER, WOLF COMPANIN etc. and PULLED FANGS.
>Is the damage from CC, GR, WC dealt by the minion?

No.

> So, is it possible
>to play PF after doing 2 damage (hand strike for 1 + CC inferior)[when
>the opposing minion does only one or less]?

No.

>3. During the last tournament a player wanted to play a Master:Skill
>on an uncontrolled vampire, because of card text "play on a vampire".
>Is this possible?

No. By default, all cards must be played on controlled, uncontested
vampires.

>4. A minion played both UNDEAD PERSISTENCE and IG. He has two optional
>presses. Can he use one to press for second round and safe the other
>to press later for third round?

No. The default for all effects generated in combat is that they expire
at the end of the round, unless otherwise stated.

>5. Is it possible to play more than one Trap each round for more than
>one press or to get rid of cards?

You can play more than one on the first round, certainly. You cannot
play them on other rounds (card text).

>6. Is it possible to prevent 2 points of damage with two SKIN OF ROCK
>inferior?

Yes. You prevent one with the first, you prevent one with the second.

>7. Lucian is bleeding with Bonding, Sir Walter Nash is tapped but
>plays 2nd Tradition. Can he play now DEFLECTION instead of blocking,
>when Lucian plays no more stealth?

No. He must attempt to block. When in a block attempt, you cannot back
out (unless you fail to generate enough stealth etc.)

--
